h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kamarhati

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kamarhati

items.pText: Kamarhati lies on the east bank of the Hooghly, just north of Kolkata, in a belt of old jute mills, mill colonies and crowded neighbourhoods. Schools, municipal parks and housing complexes here ask us for playground equipment that can take daily use in a humid climate. FunPlay Systems makes it at our factory in Vasai, about 1,650 km away, and sends it to West Bengal by road.

A town built on jute knows rope better than most, and rope is one of the most popular parts of a modern playground. Climbing nets, rope bridges and hanging rings let children climb, balance and swing in ways a slide cannot offer. Our play rope is made for outdoor use and carries a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Like any rope, it lasts longer when it is checked and cared for, especially through a long Bengal monsoon.

props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Looking after rope nets and climbers

c: Run a hand along the main ropes every month and look for fraying, cuts or flattened strands. Check that knots and connectors are tight and that the net has not slipped on its frame. Rope dries slowly in humid air, so place climbing nets where they get sun and a breeze. Never let children tie extra ropes or cloth onto the equipment. If a rope is damaged, close that piece and call our after-sales team for a replacement.

items.q: How long does play rope last outdoors?
items.a: Our play rope is made for outdoor use and carries a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Regular checks for fraying and loose knots, and a sunny, airy spot, help it last.

items.q: What should we do if a climbing net is damaged?
items.a: Close that piece to children straight away and contact our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 with photos. We will advise on repair or a replacement net.

items.q: Do you supply Kamarhati and the north Kolkata area?
items.a: Yes. We deliver from our Vasai factory to Kamarhati and nearby towns along the Hooghly by road, and install with our own team or a dealer in eastern India.
